_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. urlTemplate is filled in by `node search.js capture`.

dates._weekdaysHelp: null = every day. [5,0] = Fridays and Sundays only (0=Sun..6=Sat).

_tripLengthHelp: null = one-way search. 7 = also request a return 7 days later.
_settleSelectorHelp: Optional CSS selector that appears when results render; speeds up each search.
